segments.speaker: Analyst
segments.text: Maria, please walk us through how you enter an order.

segments.speaker: Maria Keller
segments.text: Every order arrives by email. First I find the customer in Order Desk.

segments.speaker: Maria Keller
segments.text: Then I choose the product, type the quantity and the delivery date, and save the order.

segments.speaker: Maria Keller
segments.text: After saving, I copy the order line into our tracking sheet in Excel, by hand.

segments.speaker: Maria Keller
segments.text: Then New order, and Order Desk is ready for the next one.

segments.speaker: Maria Keller
segments.text: Northwind I find by their customer number.

segments.speaker: Maria Keller
segments.text: Northwind wants a printed confirmation with every order, so I print it.

segments.speaker: Maria Keller
segments.text: The office chair is new in the sheet, so I look up its SAP material in the mapping file.

segments.speaker: Maria Keller
segments.text: Brightline is a new customer, so I create them first.

segments.speaker: Maria Keller
segments.text: I check the total in Calculator before I type it into the sheet.

segments.speaker: Analyst
segments.text: Is that check part of the process?

segments.speaker: Maria Keller
segments.text: No, it is just my habit.

segments.speaker: Maria Keller
segments.text: That is the wrong customer, I cancel and search again.

segments.speaker: Maria Keller
segments.text: And the Fabrikam line goes into the sheet as well.

segments.speaker: Analyst
segments.text: Thank you, that is all four orders.
